about.metaDescription: Dayront processes your files entirely in your browser. No uploads, no servers, just fast and private media tools. Learn about our mission and philosophy.
about.heading: About Dayront
about.intro: We believe your files should never leave your device. That's why we built Dayront — a complete suite of media tools that run entirely in your browser.
ourStory: Dayront started with a simple frustration. Every online converter wanted us to upload our files to some unknown server. A family video, a voice memo with sensitive information, a podcast draft — all of it would leave our computers and sit on someone else's hard drive. We didn't like that. And we figured you probably don't either.

In 2024, a small group of developers and privacy advocates got together and asked: what if we could bring powerful media processing tools directly to people's browsers? No uploads, no accounts, no tracking. Just open a website, drop your file, and get your result. All locally. All private.

The technology was ready. The same battle‑tested media engines that power the world's most popular apps could now run inside a browser. The pieces were there. We just had to put them together in a way that felt simple, fast, and trustworthy.

That's how Dayront was born. A tool built for everyone — journalists handling sensitive recordings, podcasters editing on the go, students working on projects, musicians tweaking audio files, and anyone who values their digital privacy.

paragraphs: When you use Dayront, everything happens right inside your browser. We harness a powerful, industry‑standard media processing engine that runs directly on your device — the same kind of technology used by the most trusted audio and video applications.
Here's what happens when you convert a file:

steps.title: You select your file
steps.text: it stays in your computer's memory.

steps.title: The engine loads
steps.text: a small, self‑contained module that runs without any server connection.

steps.title: Processing begins
steps.text: the conversion or editing happens entirely within a secure, sandboxed environment in your browser tab.

steps.title: You download the result
steps.text: the processed file is saved directly to your downloads folder. No copy ever leaves your device.

about.howItWorksFooter: At no point during this process do we — or anyone else — have access to your files. The server only sends the initial website. After that, your browser takes over completely.
about.offlineNote: This also means Dayront works offline after the first visit. Once the core files are cached by your browser, you can use most tools without an internet connection. On a plane? In a remote area with spotty signal? Dayront keeps working.
privacyPhilosophy: We're not just saying "your files are safe" because it sounds good. We designed the entire architecture around that promise. Dayront has no file storage, no user database, no analytics that track individual behavior, and no server‑side processing for media files.

Most "free online tools" aren't really free — you pay with your data. Your uploaded files might be scanned for ad targeting, stored indefinitely, or even leaked in a data breach. We think that's unacceptable.

Dayront's business model is straightforward: we display a small number of privacy‑friendly ads that never block your conversion. You get free, unlimited tools. We get enough to cover hosting costs. No data collection, no selling of information, no creepy tracking across the web.

This commitment extends to our design choices. No sign‑up forms. No email collection. No cookies beyond what's strictly necessary for the theme and language preference you set. We built Dayront to be the tool we'd want to use ourselves — and we're pretty picky about privacy.

paragraphs: Dayront serves a wide range of people around the world. Here are some of the communities we're proud to support:

list.title: Journalists & researchers
list.text: who handle sensitive audio and video material that can't be uploaded to third‑party servers.

list.title: Podcasters & content creators
list.text: who need quick, reliable conversions between formats while editing on the go.

list.title: Musicians & sound designers
list.text: who process samples, change tempos, or convert lossless files.

list.title: Students & educators
list.text: who work on multimedia projects without access to expensive software.

list.title: Privacy advocates & activists
list.text: who refuse to compromise their data for basic file processing.

list.title: People with limited internet
list.text: Dayront works offline after the first load and processes everything locally.

about.whoUsesFooter: We're constantly inspired by the creative ways people use Dayront. From archiving family videos to preparing audio evidence for court, from creating sound effects to extracting music from old video files — Dayront helps people do more with their media, privately.

paragraphs: We're far from done. Here's what we're working on:

list.title: Batch processing
list.text: convert multiple files at once, saving you time on large projects.

list.title: More video tools
list.text: trimming, cropping, and basic editing without leaving your browser.

list.title: More languages
list.text: we want Dayront to feel native to everyone, everywhere.

list.title: Improved accessibility
list.text: making sure Dayront works for people using screen readers, keyboard navigation, and other assistive technologies.

list.title: Desktop apps
list.text: a fully offline, installable version for Windows, Mac, and Linux.

about.roadAheadFooter: Everything we build will stay true to our core promise:
about.corePromise: your files never leave your device.
team: Dayront is built by a small, distributed team of developers, designers, and privacy advocates. We work remotely, believe that basic digital tools should be free and private, and we care deeply about an internet where you don't have to trade your privacy for convenience.
We contribute to open‑source projects, sponsor privacy‑focused initiatives, and try to set an example that good tools don't need to spy on you.
about.ctaText: We'd love to hear from you. Whether you found a bug, have a feature request, or just want to say hello.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of service for using Dayront's free online media tools.
terms.heading: Terms of Service

sections.title: 1. Introduction
body: Welcome to Dayront. By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use Dayront.

Dayront provides browser‑based media conversion and editing tools. The core principle of our service is that all file processing happens locally on your device — we do not have access to your files, nor do we store them on any server.

sections.title: 2. Description of Service
body: Dayront offers free online tools for audio and video processing, including but not limited to:

• Format conversion (MP4 to MP3, MP3 to WAV, and many others)
  • Audio editing (cutting, merging, compressing, volume boosting)
  • Audio effects (speed change, reversing, stereo to mono)

All processing is performed locally in your browser. No files are uploaded to our servers. The website serves only static assets — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and the necessary processing engine that runs entirely on your device.

sections.title: 3. User Responsibilities

  • You will not use Dayront to process content that is defamatory, obscene, harassing, or otherwise violates applicable laws.
Because we never see or access your files, we cannot monitor what you process. However, we reserve the right to block access to our service from any IP address or region if we become aware of misuse.

Your files remain your property. Dayront claims no ownership over any content you process through our tools. Since processing is entirely local, we never have access to your files in the first place.

privacy.metaDescription: Dayront's privacy policy: your files never leave your device. Learn how we protect your data, what we collect, and how we handle ads.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy

sections.title: 1. Our Privacy Promise
body: Dayront was built with a single, unwavering commitment: your files never leave your device. This isn't a marketing slogan — it's the fundamental architecture of our entire service.

When you use Dayront to convert, cut, merge, or edit any media file, the processing happens entirely within your browser. Your files are never uploaded to our servers. We never see them, store them, or access them in any way.
We designed Dayront to be the tool we'd want our own families to use. That means privacy isn't an afterthought — it's the foundation.

sections.title: 2. What We Don't Collect
body: Let's be absolutely clear about what Dayront does not do:

• We don't upload your files. All processing is local. We couldn't access your files even if we wanted to.
  • We don't require accounts. No sign‑up, no login, no user profiles. You use Dayront anonymously.
  • We don't track your conversions. We have no idea which files you're processing or how often.
  • We don't store your files. No server‑side storage exists for user files.
  • We don't sell data. We have no user data to sell. It's that simple.
  • We don't use invasive analytics. No fingerprinting, no cross‑site tracking, no user behavior profiling.

sections.title: 3. What We Do Collect
body: We collect the absolute minimum needed to keep the website running:

• Anonymous page view counts. We may use a privacy‑focused analytics tool that counts page visits without cookies, without tracking individuals, and without collecting personal data. This helps us understand which tools are most popular so we can improve them.
  • Your theme preference. When you toggle between light and dark mode, we save that choice in your browser's local storage. This data never leaves your device.
  • Your language preference. If you select a language, we remember it locally so you don't have to set it every visit.
  • Temporary converted files. If you enable the 24‑hour workspace feature, your processed files are stored in your browser's local database — a storage that stays on your device. You can clear this anytime.
None of this information is transmitted to us. It stays right where it belongs — on your computer.

sections.title: 4. Cookies & Local Storage
body: Dayront uses minimal local storage — not for tracking, but for basic functionality:

• Theme preference — stored locally so your dark mode choice persists.
  • Language preference — stored locally so you don't have to reselect your language.
  • Advertisement cookies — our ad partners may set cookies to serve relevant ads. These are subject to the ad network's own privacy policy.
You can clear local storage at any time through your browser settings. Dayront will continue to work perfectly without it — you'll just be back to the default theme and language.

sections.title: 5. Advertisements
body: Dayront is free and always will be. To keep the servers running, we display a small number of advertisements. Here's how we handle ads responsibly:

• Ads are placed in fixed positions that never block or interrupt your conversion process.
  • Ad containers have reserved dimensions so the page never jumps or shifts while loading.
  • We do not share any file data, personal information, or conversion details with advertisers — because we don't have any to share.
  • Ad networks may use cookies for frequency capping and basic targeting. Please refer to the respective ad network's privacy policy for more details on how they handle data.
If you have concerns about a specific advertisement you see on Dayront, please contact us and we'll investigate.

sections.title: 6. Data Security
body: Because your files never reach our servers, the primary security consideration is your own device and browser. We recommend:

• Keeping your browser updated to the latest version
  • Using a modern browser with strong security defaults (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Brave)
  • Being mindful of browser extensions that may access your browsing activity

Our website is served over HTTPS, ensuring that the connection between your browser and our server is encrypted. The processing engine that powers Dayront is served from our domain and verified for integrity.

sections.title: 7. Children's Privacy
body: Dayront is not directed at children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. Since we don't collect personal information at all, this is inherently satisfied — but we state it here for clarity.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights
body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have certain rights regarding your personal data, including the right to access, correct, delete, or port your data.

Because Dayront does not collect or store personal data, there is effectively nothing to access, correct, or delete. Your files are on your device. Your preferences are in your browser. You control everything.
If you have any questions about exercising your privacy rights, contact us and we'll respond promptly.

sections.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. When we make changes, we'll update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.
If the changes are significant, we'll place a notice on our website. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your privacy.

sections.title: 10. Contact Us
body: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your privacy while using Dayront, please reach out:
Email: privacy@dayront.com
Response time: We aim to reply to all privacy‑related inquiries within 48 hours.
For general questions or feedback, you can also email hello@dayront.com.
